visual_synopsis: A mustached man lies ill in bed while a woman doctor with a stethoscope examines him, watched by a blonde woman, a dark-haired young woman and a young man in a hoodie. Once the others leave the room, the blonde woman (a male actor in a bob wig and lipstick) stays at the bedside and the two talk for the rest of the sketch, the man gesturing weakly from his pillow.
